name: Lantern
author: E. T. Carter
description: Bioluminescent sea-lanterns — translucent glowing orbs drifting over dark water, each a structured lantern with a bright membrane rim, a shimmering caustic cell-web interior and fine filament ribs radiating from a hot nucleus. Overlaps bloom brighter as they breathe.

params.label: Drift speed
params.effect: Speed of the lanterns' drift, breathing and interior caustic crawl.

params.label: Lantern size
params.effect: Radius of the lantern bells, from compact orbs to frame-filling globes.

params.label: Structure
params.effect: Amount of interior caustic web and radial rib detail; at 0 the lanterns soften toward plain glow, at 1 the internal structure reads sharply.

params.label: Lantern count
params.effect: How many big hero jellies drift in the frame at once (the far haze adds many more behind them).

params.label: Depth spread
params.effect: Scatters lanterns through depth: at 0 all sit on one plane, sharp and equal; toward 1 a random share recede — smaller, dimmer and blurred — for a layered out-of-focus field.

params.label: Shape variation
params.effect: Per-lantern shape randomness: at 0 every bell is a clean circle; toward 1 each is squashed to its own oval, tilted off-axis, and given a tri-lobe rim wobble so no two read alike.

params.label: Tentacles
params.effect: Length and presence of the fine tentacle fringe radiating around each hero bell's rim (read top-down, so it haloes the whole margin); 0 removes it, 1 streams a long waving fringe.

params.label: Background haze
params.effect: Density of the four animated parallax layers of low-detail jellies drifting behind the hero bells; each bell grows small→big→small and its opacity tracks its size (small ones faded, large ones opaque). The main lever for filling the frame.

params.label: Variety
params.effect: How much each hero jelly randomizes its own size, brightness, interior detail and hue, so the school reads as many individuals instead of clones.

params.label: Atmosphere
params.effect: Drifting colored water-glow that fills the frame between lanterns so it never reads as dead black.

params.label: Colour spread
params.effect: How far the lantern hues range across the palette; 0 is a single tint, 1 spreads the full set.

params.label: Colour vividness
params.effect: Vividness of the lantern colours; 0 is greyscale, 1 is the raw palette, higher pushes saturation.
